title: Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights
abstract: arXiv:2610.14180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. translated_title: 无约束开放权重的 CTI-REALM 基准
translated_abstract: 希望将语言模型智能体用于安全工作的组织面临一个选择：是使用可以自行运行和审计的开放权重模型，还是使用昂贵得多的闭源前沿模型。我们在 CTI-REALM（arXiv:2603.13517）上研究了这一选择，该基准要求智能体通过查询实时遥测数据存储，将威胁情报报告转化为可用的检测规则。我们在统一的测试框架、评分器和 LLM 评审团下评估了二十六个模型，其中十九个为开放权重模型，七个为闭源模型。我们的主要发现是：只要给予足够的轮次，开放权重模型能以不到闭源模型十分之一的成本媲美最强的闭源模型。该基准公布的智能体消息数量限制是一个混淆因素：一项耗尽消息限额的任务在所有检查点上的得分都为零，包括它已经通过的检查点，因此在该限制下的结果部分衡量的是哪些模型能及时完成任务。在公布的限制下，领先的开放权重模型和闭源模（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 开放权重模型只要获得足够的交互轮次，就能以不到最强闭源模型十分之一的成本在 CTI-REALM 威胁情报检测任务上与之媲美，而原基准的消息数量限制会混淆评估结果。
en_tdlr: Open-weight models can match the strongest closed frontier models on CTI-REALM threat-intelligence detection tasks at less than a tenth of the cost when given enough turns, while the benchmark's published agent message limit acts as a confound.
